scripts.dev:control-center: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron -c cyan,magenta "pnpm dev:renderer" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env OPENPETS_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 pnpm dev:electron"
scripts.package: pnpm package:preflight && pnpm build && node scripts/clean-package-output.cjs && electron-builder
scripts.package:dir: pnpm package:preflight && pnpm build && node scripts/clean-package-output.cjs && electron-builder --dir && node dist/check-packaging-contract.js --output
scripts.package:brainpet:portable: pnpm build && node scripts/brainpet-package.mjs --target portable --mode private-test
scripts.package:brainpet:unpacked: pnpm build && node scripts/brainpet-package.mjs --target dir --mode private-test
scripts.test:brainpet-foundation: pnpm build && cross-env BRAINPET_SMOKE_TASK=foundation-probe node scripts/brainpet-electron-smoke.mjs ../../output/playwright/brainpet-foundation-probe.png
scripts.test:brainpet-stress: pnpm build && cross-env BRAINPET_LIFECYCLE_CYCLES=100 node scripts/brainpet-electron-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:brainpet-rollback: pnpm build && cross-env BRAINPET_EXPECT_DISABLED=1 node scripts/brainpet-electron-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:brainpet-openpets-isolation: pnpm build && cross-env OPENPETS_DISTRIBUTION_PROFILE=openpets BRAINPET_EXPECT_OPENPETS_ISOLATION=1 node scripts/brainpet-electron-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:brainpet-idle-soak: pnpm package:brainpet:unpacked && cross-env BRAINPET_PERFORMANCE_GATE=idle-24h BRAINPET_IDLE_SOAK_MS=86400000 BRAINPET_ELECTRON_EXECUTABLE=dist-brainpet/private-test/win-unpacked/brainpet.exe BRAINPET_PACKAGE_RECEIPT=dist-brainpet/private-test/brainpet-package-receipt-windows-x64.json node scripts/brainpet-electron-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:brainpet-soak: pnpm package:brainpet:unpacked && cross-env BRAINPET_PERFORMANCE_GATE=active-30m BRAINPET_SOAK_MS=1800000 BRAINPET_ELECTRON_EXECUTABLE=dist-brainpet/private-test/win-unpacked/brainpet.exe BRAINPET_PERFORMANCE_EXECUTABLE=dist-brainpet/private-test/win-unpacked/brainpet.exe BRAINPET_PACKAGE_RECEIPT=dist-brainpet/private-test/brainpet-package-receipt-windows-x64.json node scripts/brainpet-electron-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:brainpet-completion: pnpm build && cross-env BRAINPET_SMOKE_TASK=cargo-signal BRAINPET_VERIFY_COMPLETION=1 node scripts/brainpet-electron-smoke.mjs ../../output/playwright/brainpet-completion.png
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
